What We Do

Interior Renovation Services

Get a Free Quote
Service 01
Flooring Installation

Hardwood, luxury vinyl plank, laminate, and tile installation. We handle subfloor prep, leveling, layout, and clean edge work. The kind of detail-focused finish work that makes a floor look like it was always meant to be there.

Get a Quote
Service 02
Trim & Millwork

Baseboards, crown molding, window and door casings, and wainscoting. Trim is where precision really shows. Tight miters, clean caulk lines, no gaps. It's one of our strongest suits and a great entry point for new customers.

Get a Quote
Service 03
Drywall & Painting

Drywall installation, patching, and interior painting. Whether it's a fresh coat in a single room or a full wall repair and repaint, we take the time to prep properly because a great paint job is 80% prep work.

Get a Quote
Service 04
Bathroom Renovation

Tile work, vanity installation, shower and tub surrounds, and fixture upgrades. We handle the interior finish work ourselves. Any plumbing that requires a license is coordinated through our trusted subcontractors.

Get a Quote
Service 05
Kitchen Remodeling

Cabinet installation, countertop replacement, backsplash tiling, and lighting upgrades. We manage the interior finish work and coordinate licensed electrical or plumbing through subcontractors.

Get a Quote
Service 06
Basement Finishing

Framing, insulation, drywall, flooring, and trim work to turn an unfinished basement into usable living space. A larger-scale project that we manage carefully from start to finish, with licensed subcontractors brought in for any major electrical work.

Why Choose Us

Where the Big Guys
Drop the Ball

Bigger Companies Prioritize Volume

As contractors scale up, quality often takes a back seat. Jobs get rushed, details get missed, and homeowners are left with work that's "good enough." We're not built that way, we take on fewer jobs specifically so nothing falls through the cracks.

We're Detail-Oriented by Nature

We approach every project with an engineer's mindset. We measure carefully, think through the sequence, and don't move on until the last detail is right. That precision carries through every phase of the job, from prep to final walkthrough.

Licensed Trades, Properly Handled

We don't pretend to do everything ourselves. For work that legally requires a license, electrical, plumbing, and HVAC, we bring in trusted subcontractors and coordinate the whole job. You get the right people for every part of the project.

Straightforward Quotes, No Games

We walk the property ourselves, measure everything, and build your estimate from the ground up. You'll know exactly where every dollar goes before we start.

Who We Are

Meet the Jacksons

Owner & Lead
Jordan Jackson

As the founder of our company, Jordan and his father shared a dream of building a house together. So in his freshman year at Miami University, studying Mechanical Engineering and Engineering Management, he formed our LLC to make that dream come true. Learning everything side by side with his dad, he possess the skills to execute small-scale renovations with precision.

Carpenter
Thomas Jackson

The other half of this operation is Jordan's father. He is a captain at Springdale Fire Department, possessing lots of leadership skills and a determined mindset. Thomas has had a passion for carpentry for the past decade and it is his favorite past time. Putting small details first, he cares about making everything perfect, even if it is so small someone else may not notice it.

We're building this company from the ground up by winning on quality and reliability, not by undercutting everyone or promising more than we can deliver. If you're a homeowner or investor looking for a small-scale renovation done with real attention to detail, we'd love to earn your trust.

How It Works

Our Simple Process

1
Walk the Property

We come to you, measure the space, take photos, and draw out the project. We understand the job before a number is ever put on paper.

2
Clear, Itemized Estimate

You get a written estimate broken down clearly. No surprise add-ons halfway through the job.

3
We Get to Work

We show up on schedule and stay in communication throughout. If licensed subcontractors are needed, they're coordinated by us.

4
Final Walkthrough

Before we call it done, we walk the finished project with you and review every detail. We don't leave until you're genuinely happy with the result.
